# Spec templates

Blank versions of the three spec files. Copy them when you start a new module,
then fill them in.

| Template | Copy it to | What it is for |
|----------|-----------|----------------|
| [01-requirements.template.md](01-requirements.template.md) | `docs/specs/01-requirements.md` | What the module must do, and how we check it |
| [02-design.template.md](02-design.template.md) | `docs/specs/02-design.md` | How it is put together: data, rules, screens |
| [03-tasks.template.md](03-tasks.template.md) | `docs/specs/03-tasks.md` | The build order, with a check for each step |

## How to use them

1. Copy a template and remove `.template` from the name.
2. Replace everything in `[square brackets]`.
3. Delete the grey hint lines (the lines that start with `>`) once you have written your own text.
4. Keep the section order. The AI and your reviewers rely on it.

If you are adding to an existing project, do **not** copy a template over the
existing file. Add your new rows and sections below the existing ones instead, and leave
the existing ones as they are.
